title: A collectible lookup in Loading has no cancel and no owner, so a late answer opens the box after the user moved on, and a lookup that never answers blocks a re-tap
trigger: Tap a username, switch chat or close the profile before the answer; or lose the answer and tap the same entity again
effect: The box pops up over the new screen; request_collectible_info returns Ok(None) for a Loading lookup of the same entity, so the retry is never sent
fix: tie the lookup to the asking profile or window and clear it with the owner; let a re-tap resend after a timeout or connection loss

title: Closing the form during a 3-D Secure wait resets Verifying, so a second giveaway can be bought
trigger: Pay a new giveaway, get the provider verification step (launch = Verifying{chat}), close the giveaway form (for_form turns Verifying into Idle), reopen the form for the same chat and press Start again
effect: Start is enabled again (is_done_for false, giveaway_paying false once the sendPaymentForm answered) and a second checkout for the same giveaway opens while the first is still unresolved at the provider
fix: Keep Verifying/Paid per chat until the verification outcome or logout; for_form must only drop Failed and Launched

title: Two sources for the note under the form: form.note and launch.failure_for
trigger: A prepaid launch fails (launch = Failed{chat}), then the user edits the form
effect: edit_giveaway clears form.note but the Failed reason stays drawn (it is read from the session slot until the next open/close), so the line the user just 'dismissed' by editing stays; conversely a form.note hides the launch failure
fix: One `Notice` enum on the form (None / Refused(text) / LaunchFailed), set from the launch answer and cleared by edit

title: Giveaway form stage is split across GiveawayForm::page (screen) and GiveawayState::launch (session)
trigger: Press Start on a prepaid giveaway: page Confirming -> Form is reset by hand in start_prepaid_giveaway after the driver set launch=Launching; open/close reset launch by hand with `std::mem::take(..).for_form()` from two call sites
effect: No bug found today, but the 'what the form shows' (Confirming, Launching, Launched, Failed, Paid, Verifying) is derived from two values in two owners that must change together
fix: One per-form stage enum `FormStage { Editing, Confirming, Launching{request}, Launched, Failed(reason), Paid, Verifying }` held by the form and driven by the answers

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_welcome_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure called more than once for one built dialog
effect: second call draws an empty body; borrow_mut can panic if re-entered
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure

title: Password field is emptied and a wrong note shown when the transfer was not sent
trigger: Press Change owner with an empty password (or a driver refusal returning Ok(None)); driver returns Ok(None) without sending
effect: Field is cleared anyway and the note says 'Ownership can't be transferred right now' though nothing was tried
fix: Clear the field only when the request was handed to TDLib; say what is missing otherwise

title: tray_photo_size holds photo_sizes.borrow_mut() across a file-header read on the render thread
trigger: A photo joins the tray; the options row renders and reads image_dimensions from disk inside or_insert_with
effect: Disk IO on the UI thread per new photo (slow or network path stalls a frame); long-held borrow across a call into another module
fix: Read the size in the media-check worker (check_photo already opens it) and store it in MediaCheck

title: The video sound-track read has no give-up timer, unlike the thumbnail and media reads
trigger: Attach a video whose ffprobe hangs or whose worker dies
effect: tray_videos_checking stays true, Send answers 'Checking the video, send again' forever until the file is removed
fix: Add the GIVE_UP_AFTER settle (as send_box_thumbnails.rs) so Reading { job } always has a way out

title: The story media file dialog answer is applied to whichever composer is open when it returns
trigger: Click the composer preview (file dialog opens), close the composer and open another one (edit or repost), then choose a file
effect: spawn_screen carries only the screen epoch, so take_story_media sets the media on the new composer, which the user never asked to change
fix: Carry a composer token (open counter or the stage owner key) in the continuation and apply the pick only when it still matches

title: StoryComposer::open is a bool beside stage and mode, and the Esc layer reads it separately
trigger: Open and close the story composer
effect: No bug today: close() resets the whole value so open and stage agree, but the box-open stage is a bool that every opener (open, open_edit, open_repost) must set together with the stage
fix: StoryUi::composer as Option<StoryComposer> (None is closed) so open is the variant, not a flag

title: The 4-hour recheck turns DownloadFailed/InstallFailed into Available, and auto_download retries on its own
trigger: A download or hand-off fails; wait for the timer (recheck skips only Installed). The check result is Available, apply_check_result calls auto_download_update.
effect: Failed download is retried silently every 4 hours and the failure message is lost, against the control's own rule that a failed download waits for the button.
fix: recheck_for_updates skips every failed stage, or keep the failure in the stage the check returns to

title: Banner visibility is two fields: update_state==Installed and update_banner_dismissed
trigger: Dismiss the banner (flag true); only check_for_updates resets it.
effect: None today; the flag is reset in one place and read in app_render/mod.rs:342.

title: Checking and Downloading name detached tasks; the only cancel is an AtomicBool in the progress
trigger: check, download, redraw timer and the 4-hour loop are all .detach()ed; UpdateState::Downloading holds only DownloadProgress (held flag).
effect: Owner going away (lock, log-out) cannot stop them; the 4-hour recheck loop and downloads run while locked or logged out; results are applied by state shape, not by a held request id.
fix: Hold the Task in the stage (Checking(Task), Downloading{task, timer, progress}) so replacing the stage cancels it

title: Installing has no exit if the quit does not end the process
trigger: hand_off succeeds, state = Installing, cx.quit() is held up or refused.
effect: Button hidden and disabled (Restarting) with nothing to leave the stage; needs restart.
fix: Installing with a way out (quit failed -> InstallFailed)
